thread:
alex.marketing: Heads up team 10: we want to publish the embeddings + hosting update next Wed. Need final changelog line, docs anchor, short hero blurb, and webinar + benchmark plan. Owners?

sam.engineering: Ill handle changelog and rollout ops. Thinking canary Wed 08:30 PT -> 20m soak -> progressive 5/20/60/100. Is that schedule OK for marketing timing?

hina.docs: I'll own docs + migration guide. Need the exact API response shape and the sample cURL. Can devs paste?

noah.product: Webinar: 45min demo + 15min q&a on Thurs 10am PT. Marketing to confirm promotion cadence. We want a short migration checklist in the webinar slides.

maya.salesops: Routing: route registrants to SDR; if lead score >70 and company_size >250 => AE. Ill prepare CSV export mapping.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: job rdw-emb-v3-canary (id:1122334455) scheduled Wed 08:30 PT.

alex.marketing: Great. Hina, docs blurbs should be short: 1 sentence hero + 3 quick bullets. Also need a 2-tweet thread for announce and a longer blog.

sam.engineering: Changelog draft: "Embeddings & Hosting: serving rewrite with prefix cache and adaptive batching; ~2.1x throughput, ~35% cost reduction on mid-length batches."

hina.docs: Draft snippet for hero: "Embeddings v3: faster vectors, smoother routing, lower cost. POST /v1/embeddings returns vectors + metadata — see migration notes."

noah.product: Add note: "Default config preserves model quality; advanced quant settings available for cost-sensitive workloads."

maya.salesops: Landing page decision: marketing or product? We need GA copy + form fields: company size, use case, employee count.

alex.marketing: Marketing will host the landing page with product-provided copy. Noah please share the slide checklist by EOD.

sam.engineering: Canary started: job 1122334455 logs -> https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/1122334455/logs. So far p50=28ms p95=120ms errors 0.01%.

hina.docs: Thanks Sam. Can you paste sample response? e.g., `{ "data": [{"embedding": [0.001, ...], "id": "abc"}], "meta": {"model": "embed-v3"}}`

sam.engineering: Yup that's the shape. Also include header example: `X-Redwood-Model: embed-v3`.

alex.marketing: For the blog we want a short benchmark section: baseline vs v3 on 512-token averages and on batch sizes 1/8/64. Sam can you provide numbers by noon?

sam.engineering: Will post numbers in this thread by 11:30. Quick preview: throughput x2.1 @batch8, 35% cost delta. Full table incoming.

noah.product: Webinar slide deck draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/slides/embeddings-v3. Includes migration checklist, rollback steps, and demo script.

maya.salesops: Routing rules shortlink: https://short.redwood.ai/emb-route-v3. Tests with sample registrants passed.

deploy-bot: Canary job 1122334455 completed: status SUCCESS.

sam.engineering: Canary passed. Rolling to 5% now. Monitors: error_rate >0.3% or p95>250ms will trigger rollback.

hina.docs: Docs staging published: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/v3 - will push to prod after copy sign-off.

alex.marketing: Draft hero copy for social: "Meet Embeddings v3: faster vectors at lower cost. Live webinar Thurs 10am PT 1 Register: {landing_page}." Keep 280 chars for main tweet thread.

noah.product: Please include migration note: "No client changes required for most users; advanced users can opt into quant profiles."

sam.engineering: Rolling to 20% now. Metrics green.

alex.marketing: Chart asks: Sam, include latency histograms + cost per 1k tokens in the benchmark doc. Hina will add code snippet to docs.

hina.docs: Merging final formatting PR now. Will attach code snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{ "input": "..." }'`

\m: This bot message has an accidental prefix — remove it?

maya.salesops: Received registration export from landing page. SDR queue seeds uploaded.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: traffic at 60%.

sam.engineering: Pushing to 100% now; will monitor 30m post-rollout.

alex.marketing: Final checklist: docs prod URL, changelog link, webinar page, benchmark figures, landing page form fields. Please paste anchors now.

hina.docs: Docs prod: https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/v3#overview

sam.engineering: Changelog anchor: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog#embeddings-v3

noah.product: Webinar page: https://events.redwood.ai/embeddings-v3-register

maya.salesops: Routing shortlink: https://short.redwood.ai/emb-route-v3 1 verified.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% traffic. All monitors green.

alex.marketing: Excellent. We'll schedule publish Wednesday 12:00 PT (give us 90m buffer post-roll). Blog + tweets will go live then. Please react with :rocket: when you're good with announce copy.
